# Gamer Therapist

> > A clinical resource exploring the intersection of video games, psychotherapy, and mental health treatment.

Gamer Therapist is a professional platform by Mike Langlois dedicated to integrating video games into psychotherapeutic practice. The site serves clinicians and mental health professionals seeking evidence-based approaches to technology-integrated therapy, with a focus on conditions like PTSD and other mental health challenges.

## Key Topics

- Mike Langlois
- Reset: Video Games & Psychotherapy
- Psychotherapy
- Video Games
- Mental Health
- Clinical Practice
- PTSD
- Technology Integration
- Therapeutic Intervention
- Evidence-Based Treatment

## Core Resources

- [Book](https://gamertherapist.com/my-book): Mike Langlois's 'Reset: Video Games & Psychotherapy' book on mental health and clinical integration of gaming
